name: Idea Chain
description: Telephone-style: everyone writes a starter, then each round the ideas pass to the next person who transforms them. After 4 rounds, every chain comes back to the person who started it, and the class sees how each one evolved.
tagline: Great for creative thinking, brainstorming, and seeing how ideas mutate when they pass through different minds.

starterPrompt.label: Starting prompt
starterPrompt.helper: What students write at the very beginning. Each student writes one of these.

transformPrompt.label: How to transform each round
transformPrompt.helper: What students do with the version they receive each round: change it, twist it, or carry it forward. The same instruction is reused across all four rounds, so it must work on any version, never ask for a fresh start.
transformPrompt.placeholder: Rewrite it with one twist: change the setting, the mood, or what happens next.

timer.label: Time per round (seconds)
timer.helper: How long students have to read the previous version and add their twist.

template.name: Idea Chain
template.description: A 4-round telephone game built with the Idea Chain recipe.

intro.message:
Idea Chain

Everyone writes one idea to start. Then for 4 rounds, the idea passes to the next person, who reads the latest version and transforms it.

At the end, your own idea comes back to you, and you'll see every step it took.

evolved.content: Everyone is reading how their own idea changed, hand to hand.

gallery.message: Every chain, start to finish. Read each one out loud.

end.message: Look how far each idea travelled from where it started!
